commands.name: sbom
commands.summary: Generate one CycloneDX SBOM per deployed artifact from rush deploy output
commands.description: Discovers rush deploy scenarios (common/config/rush/deploy-*.json), locates each scenario's deploy output, and generates one validated CycloneDX 1.6 SBOM per scenario plus a manifest.json index. Requires `rush deploy` to have run first. This plugin must be installed in an autoinstaller named "rush-plugins".

parameters.description: Limit to the named deploy scenario(s). Default: every common/config/rush/deploy-*.json.
Scan this deploy folder directly, bypassing scenario discovery.
Output directory for SBOMs and manifest.json. Default: common/deploy-sbom.
Exit 3 if any generated SBOM fails CycloneDX 1.6 schema validation.
Print the run result as JSON on stdout.
